channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Allen Crabbe | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Allen Crabbe from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Allen Crabbe, Rodions Kurucs
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Atkinson on taking Kurucs out of the lineup when Allen Crabbe returns:

“He’s making it hard. That’s not going to be an easy decision. We'll look at it hard... I like that defensive versatility & that size. He keeps playing like this it’s going to be tough to take him out.”

Kenny Atkinson on Allen Crabbe, Rodions Kurucs, Dec 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Shabazz Napier on Ed Davis, Allen Crabbe

Shabazz Napier on Ed Davis, Allen Crabbe, Jul 17, 2018. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Sean Marks on Allen Crabbe, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
Sean Marks on #Nets not getting Allen Crabbe and/or Tyler Johnson:

“Yeah its definitely disappointing not to have those 2 guys; but at the same time we're excited. We're excited those guys actually chose the Nets to sign offer sheets with. That says a lot about Kenny & his staff & the vision. We’ll go back at it again. There’s certainly a Plan B & that’s in progress right now, which, again, we’re excited about.”

Sean Marks on Allen Crabbe, Tyler Johnson, Jul 11, 2016. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.
